v3_1_mire_scale_anti_corrugation_gates.purpose: Replace ONLY the window-scale anti_corrugation gate with three mire-scale gates that operationalize the brief's pre-stated 'orientation coherence localized, not mire-wide' intent. Thresholds below are frozen from peatland-patterning literature/physics reasoning BEFORE any computation on the field.

block_grid_definition.tiling: non-overlapping 64x64-cell blocks, origin at array index (0,0) of the stored whole_labels; the partial remainder strip on the high-row/high-col edge is discarded.
block_grid_definition.ridge_mask: whole_labels == RIDGE (1); this is the emergent string skeleton the corrugation gate measures.
block_grid_definition.reused_machinery: orientation resultant = gates._orientation_resultant (doubled-angle resultant of the gaussian-smoothed ridge-field gradient normal); spacing = network.skeletonize + distance-transform peak spacing (network.analyze_topology). No new estimator is introduced.

patterned_block_criterion.rule: A 64x64 block is 'patterned' iff it contains at least min_ridge_cells RIDGE cells. Outside the mire the label field is all LAWN, so this criterion restricts to mire interior with a resolvable local string field.
patterned_block_criterion.min_ridge_cells_rationale: 128 of 4096 cells (>=3.1% string coverage over a 128 m block) guarantees enough string pixels to estimate a local orientation and to contribute spacing samples; frozen from measurement-support reasoning, not from the field.

gate_a_orientation_domain_dispersion.metric: For each patterned block compute its dominant string orientation theta_b = 0.5*angle(mean(exp(2j*angle_ridge_cells))) via gates._orientation_resultant's doubled-angle construction restricted to the block. Then the mire-wide block-orientation RESULTANT R_dom = |mean over patterned blocks of exp(2j*theta_b)|; circular variance CV_circ = 1 - R_dom.
gate_a_orientation_domain_dispersion.rationale: Ombrotrophic raised-bog domes drain radially. Korotkov/Ilyasov (2026, Drones 10(2):121) and Rietkerk (2004, Am Nat 163:699) establish ridges orient PERPENDICULAR to local rainwater flow, so string orientation must rotate with the radial drainage field across the mire, populating a broad arc of orientations. A globally single-orientation field (R_dom -> 1) is the corrugation failure mode the form-graph exhibited. R_dom <= 0.50 forbids any single orientation from carrying more than half the vector coherence across blocks, while still permitting a dominant regional drainage axis. This is STRICTER than the window gate's 0.60 because at mire scale the radial dome guarantees genuine orientation diversity.

gate_b_pooled_spacing_cv.metric: Skeletonize the whole ridge mask (network.skeletonize); take distance-transform spacing peaks (network.analyze_topology spacing_samples, = 2*distance at local maxima) whose peak location falls inside a patterned block; pool them and compute CV = std/mean.
gate_b_pooled_spacing_cv.rationale: Beguin/Brunetti/Kasparian (2019, Sci Rep 9:1750) show self-organized ombrotrophic-peatland networks are percolating/branched with irregular string spacing; Korotkov (2026) reports 10-100 m ridge/hollow element dimensions -> broad spacing range. An evenly-spaced corrugation field (form-graph failure mode) has CV well below 0.35. The 0.35 floor is the same literature-derived discriminator as the window gate; pooling across the whole mire (labyrinth core + margin) only widens the spacing distribution, so 0.35 is conservative, NOT a relaxation.

gate_c_two_regimes_present.metric: Classify each patterned block by its INTERNAL orientation resultant R_int = gates._orientation_resultant restricted to the block: 'labyrinth' if R_int < 0.50, 'aligned/regular' if R_int >= 0.50. Count blocks in each class.
gate_c_two_regimes_present.pass_condition: both the labyrinth class (R_int < 0.50) and the aligned/regular class (R_int >= 0.50) contain >= 3 patterned blocks AND >= 5% of patterned blocks each.
gate_c_two_regimes_present.rationale: Rietkerk (2004) predicts a slope-governed labyrinth<->stripe transition: the flat central dome yields an isotropic maze/labyrinth (low internal coherence) and graded margins yield aligned strings transverse to flow (high internal coherence). Eppinga (2009, Am Nat 173:803) confirms maze and string forms co-occur. A genuine self-organized dome must therefore exhibit BOTH a low-coherence labyrinth population and a high-coherence aligned population; a single regime everywhere indicates a placed/thresholded field. R_int=0.50 is the natural midpoint between isotropic (0) and perfectly aligned (1); the 3-block / 5% floors ensure each regime is a real population, not noise.

v3_1_pass_condition: v3.1 PASSES iff gate_a AND gate_b AND gate_c pass AND all carried-over v3.0 gates (safety_exactness, parent_deviation, amplitude_envelope, topology, pool_coupling) are PASS. Any mire-scale gate failing = real rejection, reported exactly, no further protocol change.
